summary: The old harness cannot reach three supported gzip stream behaviors. The selected changes preserve initial header behavior and change header state on reset.

claims.necessity_reason: The compression stream supports gzip output with a default header. The harness fixes initialization to the zlib wrapper, so no fuzz input can reach that output format.

before.requirement: Deflate a gzip wrapped stream with the default gzip header when gzip window bits are selected.
before.reason: Gzip window bits select wrap 2, and initialization leaves gzhead null. The harness always uses deflateInit, which supplies MAX_WBITS and selects wrap 1.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Deflate emits the default gzip header when gzhead is null.
deflateInit delegates to deflateInit2_ with MAX_WBITS.

after.requirement: Deflate a gzip wrapped stream with the default gzip header when gzip window bits are selected.
after.reason: Gzip window bits still select wrap 2. Initialization reaches deflateResetKeep, which now clears gzhead; the harness still selects wrap 1.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The initialization call to deflateReset now sets gzhead to null.
Deflate emits the default gzip header when gzhead is null.
deflateInit delegates to deflateInit2_ with MAX_WBITS.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry supplies bytes and length but has no path that changes stream initialization.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions support the same default gzip output. The same fixed deflateInit call prevents gzip initialization on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: The compression stream supports caller supplied gzip header fields. The harness cannot select gzip wrapping or install a header for any fuzz input.

before.requirement: Emit caller supplied gzip header fields on a gzip wrapped deflate stream.
before.reason: Gzip wrapping and deflateSetHeader provide the setup, and deflate emits the supplied fields. The harness uses only the default zlib initializer and never sets a header.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Deflate writes caller supplied gzip header fields.

after.requirement: Emit caller supplied gzip header fields on a gzip wrapped deflate stream.
after.reason: Gzip wrapping and deflateSetHeader remain available. A header set after initialization is emitted by deflate, but the harness still has no such setup path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Deflate writes caller supplied gzip header fields.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry has no alternative initialization or header setup sequence.

claims.comparison_reason: The same fixed initializer and absence of deflateSetHeader block the same custom header behavior on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: The changed reset behavior affects the gzip header state used by subsequent deflate calls. A valid customized gzip stream can be reset and compressed again, but the harness has no reset sequence.

before.requirement: Discard a previously installed custom gzip header when deflateResetKeep resets the stream.
before.reason: The complete pre-change reset function did not clear gzhead; the pre-change initializer set it only when creating the stream.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Before the change, gzhead was cleared during initialization.

after.requirement: Discard a previously installed custom gzip header when deflateResetKeep resets the stream, allowing the next deflate call to emit the default gzip header.
after.reason: Reset now clears gzhead, and deflate selects its default gzip header path afterward. The harness neither installs a custom header nor resets a stream before compressing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: deflateSetHeader installs the header whose state reset now clears.
A null gzhead selects default gzip header emission.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The entry invokes one fresh compression sequence per accepted input.

claims.comparison_reason: The same reset-after-customization behavior was absent before and is supported after. The old harness cannot reach its required state sequence.
